The plan cleanly preserves C3's `execution_authorized: false` boundary, introduces zero live actuators or external side effects, strictly bounds the simulation to one in-memory service state transition and one LKG rollback, and enforces mandatory independent fresh readbacks before releasing any result.

---

## 2. Adversarial Evaluation of Mandatory Review Points

1. **Forward Capability Bounds:**  
   The plan specifies exactly one allowlisted forward runbook `restart-api-synthetic.v1` targeting only `isolated_authored_synthetic / service / synthetic:api-service` with exact empty parameters (`additionalProperties: false`). Its effect is strictly a pure state transition in an in-memory `SyntheticServiceState` from `degraded` to `healthy` ([Plan §1, §5, §6](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/model-required-bureau-c4-plan-review/docs/emr4-model-required-bureau-c4-allowlisted-actuator-simulator-plan.md#L24-L30)).

2. **Rollback & Non-Reachability:**  
   The only rollback capability is exact `restore-api-synthetic-lkg.v1`. No real process, file, database, network, socket, cloud, IAM, product route, event consumer, provider product-runtime call, or external effect is reachable ([Plan §1, §2](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/model-required-bureau-c4-plan-review/docs/emr4-model-required-bureau-c4-allowlisted-actuator-simulator-plan.md#L28-L48); [Threat Model §2](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/model-required-bureau-c4-plan-review/docs/security/emr4-model-required-bureau-c4-allowlisted-actuator-simulator-threat-model-delta.md#L19-L21)).

3. **C3 Non-Execution & Authority Separation:**  
   C3's `execution_authorized: false` remains intact. Neither model output, plan candidate text, reviewer assertions, nor plan hashes can act as execution authority. Execution requires a distinct backend-issued, opaque, server-held, one-use random evidence reference ([Plan §3, §5](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/model-required-bureau-c4-plan-review/docs/emr4-model-required-bureau-c4-allowlisted-actuator-simulator-plan.md#L72-L76)).

4. **Fail-Closed Binding & Drift Protection:**  
   Plan, decision, catalog, policy, actor/role, target/revision, observation, nonce, supersession, and earliest-expiry bindings fail closed under mismatch, drift, role loss, tampering, replay, or concurrency ([Plan §5, §6](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/model-required-bureau-c4-plan-review/docs/emr4-model-required-bureau-c4-allowlisted-actuator-simulator-plan.md#L103-L129)).

5. **Fixed Code-Level Callable Map:**  
   The handler maps runbook IDs via a fixed Python dictionary to single hard-coded callables. Shell, SQL, URL, path, template, dynamic import/reflection (`eval`, `exec`), generic tool dispatchers, and unknown parameters are structurally unreachable ([Plan §6](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/model-required-bureau-c4-plan-review/docs/emr4-model-required-bureau-c4-allowlisted-actuator-simulator-plan.md#L154-L158)).

6. **Monotone Admission & Snapshot Boundaries:**  
   Admission, idempotency sealing, and evidence consumption are monotone within a critical section. Simulated effect state and effect audit have an explicit snapshot boundary; failure or fault injection never reopens evidence or releases false success ([Plan §6, §7](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/model-required-bureau-c4-plan-review/docs/emr4-model-required-bureau-c4-allowlisted-actuator-simulator-plan.md#L165-L175)).

7. **Fresh Readback & Rollback Semantics:**  
   Success requires a separately invoked fresh read of state. Failed postconditions trigger `restore-api-synthetic-lkg.v1` followed by a second fresh read. `SIMULATED_READBACK_FAILED_ROLLBACK_VERIFIED` and `SIMULATED_ROLLBACK_UNVERIFIED` are distinct, terminal, and fail-closed; neither is represented as success ([Plan §6, §8](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/model-required-bureau-c4-plan-review/docs/emr4-model-required-bureau-c4-allowlisted-actuator-simulator-plan.md#L148-L153)).

8. **Replay & Concurrency Semantics:**  
   Same-key exact replay returns the stored receipt. Same-key fingerprint conflicts return `IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT`. In-progress keys return `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS`. Different-key evidence reuse returns `EXECUTION_EVIDENCE_REPLAY`. Concurrent requests yield at most one single handler attempt without leaking evidence references or ambient state ([Plan §6, §7, §8](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/model-required-bureau-c4-plan-review/docs/emr4-model-required-bureau-c4-allowlisted-actuator-simulator-plan.md#L176-L182)).

9. **Schemas & Denial Taxonomy:**  
   Five closed Draft 2020-12 schemas are specified alongside 17 stable sanitized denial reason codes. Non-canonical encodings, unknown properties, or executable content reject before authority or state lookup ([Plan §4, §8](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/model-required-bureau-c4-plan-review/docs/emr4-model-required-bureau-c4-allowlisted-actuator-simulator-plan.md#L80-L98)).

10. **API Spine Alignment:**  
    No mounted FastAPI, REST, or GraphQL route or external event consumer is added. GraphQL remains read-only. Declarative OpenAPI contracts are explicitly marked `not_mounted` and unimported by `app.main` ([Plan §9](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/model-required-bureau-c4-plan-review/docs/emr4-model-required-bureau-c4-allowlisted-actuator-simulator-plan.md#L207-L216)).

11. **Claim & Evidence Label Boundary:**  
    The evidence label is strictly `provider_free_authored_synthetic_allowlisted_actuator_simulation`. It cannot support `live_actuator`, `live_recovery`, `real_database`, `deployment`, `production`, or `release` claims ([Plan §11](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/model-required-bureau-c4-plan-review/docs/emr4-model-required-bureau-c4-allowlisted-actuator-simulator-plan.md#L259-L263)).

12. **AER-0023 Accounting:**  
    AER-0023 ([`docs/ariadne-agent-error-correction-register-revision-17.md`](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/model-required-bureau-c4-plan-review/docs/ariadne-agent-error-correction-register-revision-17.md#L7-L24)) preserves the failed `pre_plan` runtime state and receipt, admits only the corrected `pre_sprint_planning` receipt (`model-required-bureau-c4-preplan-2-receipt.json`), and correctly attributes the incident to an orchestrator event-name contract error without implying a repository, transport, or model failure.
